previous_versions.body:
My concern is that you cannot necessarilly assume that input that has reached the stages described in 5.2.x and 5.3.x has undergone validation, maybe it has and maybe it hasn't. It depends on the source. Similarly, by the time you get to those stages, e.g. inserting into eval or creating a dynamic query, it may be too late to just reject the input without causing significant user experience problems.

To me the important thing is that input validation should be enforced wherever possible but that sanitization/encoding should take place when content reaches that particular context.

What do you think? How do you think we could make things as clear as possible here?
